# Amadeus Persona
简体中文 · Detailed configuration · Issues
One core identity and reusable Scene styles, injected as independent System Prompt sections.
Target package: **`@fg-lab/amadeus-persona@1.2.0`**. Tested runtime baseline: official DSH Desktop *
*0.2.1-rc.3**. MIT licensed.
## Release status
**1.2.0 is published:** GitHub Release · npm. Install the pinned version and verify the release chec
ksum. Later main changes do not change this immutable archive. See publishing policy.
## What you can do
- Edit one shared SOUL core identity and any number of reusable STYLE cards, with versions and backu

ps.
- Select a default style for one Workspace and override individual Sessions or trusted QQ Scenes

; choose inherit, core-only or disabled when appropriate.
- Update persona at a later model assembly
without changing the Agent Preset or rebuilding an existing Session. Ongoing tool calls are not int

errupted.
- Use the bilingual console's library, bindings and diagnostics; inspect conflicts and fin
al System Prompt visibility.
Example: keep the same core identity for a project, use a concise style in a work Session and a conv
ersational style in an authorized QQ group. Scene members share that Scene style, not private memory
an authorized QQ group. Scene members share that Scene style, not private memory from other Scenes.
Persona creates neither a new model nor new tool permissions. Other Workspaces and subagents are exc
luded by default. A persona edit can affect request-series or prompt-cache reuse; long conversation
context may still influence wording. A configured card is not proof of final injection: use diagnost
ext may still influence wording. A configured card is not proof of final injection: use diagnostics.
## Install and configure
Install the prebuilt `.tgz` with the official DSH plugin manager into your selected Profile. No loca
l source build is required. Follow installation instructions; do not copy configuration into a runni
equired. Follow installation instructions; do not copy configuration into a running Profile by hand.
Open the Persona console, bind one Workspace, save your own core card and optionally create styles a
nd bindings. An empty install imposes no persona.
The other Amadeus plugins are optional. Install only the integrations you need.
## Interface
This is a recorded interface screenshot, not evidence that every real platform capability passed the
current release gate. See the detailed reference and verification reports for limitations.
## Upgrade and recovery
Back up user data before upgrading. Code, persistent user data and recovery backups are separate. Di
sable stops functionality; uninstall is intended to retain external data. Restoring old code alone d
oes not reverse a database migration.
